title: UCLA students plan pro-Palestine demonstration on October 7 anniversary

tea.why: Students are protesting to commemorate three years of what they describe as "escalated genocide in Palestine" and to uplift Palestinian resistance.
tea.want: Organizers aim to channel grief into political action and work towards the "inevitable reality of liberation" for Palestinians.
tea.changed: Oct 7: Students for Justice in Palestine at UCLA scheduled a protest at Bruin Plaza to mark the third anniversary of the Oct 7 Hamas attack.

summary: Students for Justice in Palestine at UCLA announced a protest scheduled for October 7 at noon at Bruin Plaza. The demonstration aims to commemorate three years since what the group described as "escalated genocide in Palestine" and to "recognize and uplift" Palestinian resistance (Source 1, 2). The organization stated its purpose is to channel grief over the conflict into political action, working towards "liberation" (Source 1, 2). Critics online called the event "depraved" and some planned counter-protests (Source 1, 2).
organizers: Students for Justice in Palestine at UCLA
demands: Commemorate three years of escalated genocide in Palestine
response: No official response from university or police authorities regarding the scheduled protest was reported in the sources.

updates.text: Students for Justice in Palestine at UCLA announced a protest scheduled for noon at Bruin Plaza to mark the third anniversary of the Oct 7 Hamas attack.

sources.title: Students at LA top college plot ‘depraved’ stunt to mark massacre that shocked the world
Woke UCLA students are planning pro-Palestinian march on 3rd anniversary of October 7 attacks that saw Hamas murder 1,200 Israelis
